prose.description: Shark, at the centre of the Swamp, is its trading hub: a town of Swampers, outlaws and gangs, where Big Grim's Hounds call the shots. Big Darkbrow's Blackshifters run a casino bar, and the Dancing Skeleton is the place for trade and news. Blood spiders, drunk thugs and raids by Red Sabres and Swamp Ninjas keep it dangerous.
